notes: Field names are camelCase per the CAT-stream transcription convention. docs/technical/40-content-data-and-validation.md:92-100 instead mandates snake_case property names with _m/_m_per_s/_seconds/_hull/_percent suffixes and the common definition envelope at lines 76-89 (id, schema_version, content_version, status, name_key, summary_key, tags, source_refs, presentation_id). Only `id` is emitted here; the remaining envelope fields have no authored values in docs/ and are left to the schema stream (DAT-001..003).
`M` is one unmodified mech collision diameter (1.0 M), per docs/72-player-survivability-and-damage-baseline.md:47. Keys suffixed `M` or `MPerSecond` use that unit, not metres.
Percentages are transcribed as {"percent": N} objects; ranges as {"min": X, "max": Y}.

docs/data/contact-damage-pressure.csv and docs/data/survivability-baseline.csv are non-authoritative mirrors (docs/data/README.md:5,10) and were used only to cross-check. Every overlapping value agrees with the Markdown.
`arrival.activeSecondsIntoRun` is the doc's 7:00 timecode converted to active simulation seconds; the timecode is preserved verbatim.
No document states a boss Armor value; ordinary enemies are explicitly 0 Armor (docs/31-...md:25) but bosses are not covered, so `armor` is null.
Boss Hull values are initial anchors validated against the no-relic progression in docs/71-initial-weapon-numeric-catalog.md, not a substitute for time-to-kill validation (docs/31-...md:128).
No presentation entry ID exists anywhere in docs/, so the presentation reference required by docs/technical/40-content-data-and-validation.md:114 is omitted.

definingBehavior: Telegraphs and performs a straight charge
behaviorKind: persistent giant pursuer with exactly one additional behavior

contactFootprint.appendagesOutsideFootprint: may pass over the mech harmlessly
contactFootprint.attackGeometryUsesSeparateDisplay: charge lanes, projectile shapes, and landing circles use their separately displayed attack geometry rather than the boss contact circle

damagePressure.assumptions: 100 Hull, zero Armor, no healing, no resonance, uninterrupted overlap with one attacker

milestoneReachTargetProbability.cohort: players who understand movement and fabrication but have no permanent PowerUps

ability.targeting: displays a wide straight charge lane toward the mech's sampled position
ability.laneValidation: the lane never knowingly selects a route that immediately collides with terrain before covering one body length
ability.terrainInteraction: terrain stops the charge without stunning or damaging the boss
ability.missConsequence: missing carries Riftjaw past the player and creates a brief damage opportunity before pursuit resumes
ability.hitRule: a dedicated per-ability hit rule rather than the ordinary 18 contact
ability.designRole: checks movement, facing awareness, and early single-target damage without adding projectiles or summons

persistence.spawnRule: enters from valid navigable ground outside the camera; never on the mech, inside an active mining zone, or in an unavoidable collision path

reentry.trigger: remains far outside the combat area
reentry.behavior: re-enters from a telegraphed valid off-screen approach

resonance.controlResistanceCombinesWithDriftmetal: without reaching complete immunity unless a later rule says so

defeatReward.materialSelection: each unit independently selects one of the four materials present in the geological profile, with duplicates allowed and absent materials excluded
defeatReward.delivery: non-modal physical loot burst scattered onto valid nearby ground, contact-collected, persisting until collected or run end, with an immediate minimap marker

description: Riftjaw is a long burrowing predator with an armored wedge head and a segmented body that remains fully visible above ground during ordinary pursuit.
